plan.objective: Make account search match on email address as well as name
expectedSchemas: account object: { name: string, email?: string }
plan.intent: Additive behavior change: widen searchAccounts in src/search/accounts.js so a trimmed, lowercased query matches a case-insensitive substring of either account.name or account.email (tolerating missing/non-string email), instead of name only; existing name matching and the empty-query-returns-empty guard are preserved, and test/search.test.js gains email-match coverage. No other module, API surface, or configuration is touched.

plan.objective: Round every amount a customer is shown to whole pence so totals never display long decimals
plan.intent: Change the customer-facing rounding precision in src/format/money.js from whole pounds (PLACES = 0) to whole pence (PLACES = 2), so roundMoney — and its existing consumers formatMoney and orderTotal — emit two-decimal amounts instead of long decimals; no functions, modules, or public APIs are added or removed.

plan.objective: Retry webhook delivery up to three times when the transport reports a failure
expectedSchemas: deliver return value: { url: string, delivered: boolean, attempts: number }
plan.intent: Add bounded retry behavior to webhook delivery: re-invoke the injected transport after a reported failure for up to three total attempts, stopping at the first success, while preserving the existing { url, delivered } return shape and adding an attempts count.

plan.objective: Record the originating IP address on every audit entry
expectedSchemas: audit entry object: { actor, action, subject, ip }
plan.intent: Add an originating IP field to audit entries by extending auditEntry with an optional ip parameter that is always included (normalized to null when absent) on the returned entry object, and cover it in the audit test; no existing behavior is removed or disabled.

plan.objective: Add a created-at column to the CSV export
expectedSchemas: CSV export row shape (id, name, status, createdAt)
plan.intent: Adding behavior: append a new "createdAt" column to the end of the COLUMNS list in src/export/csv.js so exportColumns() and toCsv() emit it after id,name,status (missing values fall back to the existing "" default), and extend test/export.test.js to cover the new column. No columns are removed or reordered, no existing behavior is disabled, and no other module or test is touched.

plan.objective: Orders paid by card should cost an extra five percent on top of what the customer would otherwise pay
expectedSchemas: order object gains an optional payment method field (e.g. order.payment.method === "card") consumed by pricing; no persisted/DB schema exists in this repository
plan.intent: Add a new pricing behavior: a 5% card-payment surcharge applied to the otherwise-final order amount (line items after discount, plus delivery, plus tax) before customer-facing rounding, following the existing src/pricing module + matching test-file convention; no existing behavior is removed or disabled, and non-card orders are unchanged.

plan.objective: Add a flat two pound handling charge to every order's total
plan.intent: Adds a new flat 2.00 handling charge constant to orderTotal in src/pricing/total.js, applied to every order alongside the existing DELIVERY constant and included in the pre-tax subtotal so it is taxed consistently; no existing behavior is removed or disabled.

plan.objective: Orders of one hundred pounds or more should not be charged for delivery, and every other order should be charged three pounds
plan.intent: Add a conditional free-delivery rule inside src/pricing/total.js: introduce a FREE_DELIVERY_THRESHOLD of 100 alongside the existing DELIVERY constant of 3, and make orderTotal charge 0 for delivery when the discounted order value is greater than or equal to 100 while still adding 3 otherwise. This adds new threshold behavior; it does not remove the existing delivery charge, alter discount (src/pricing/discount.js), tax (src/pricing/tax.js), or rounding (src/format/money.js), and it does not touch the notify, audit, export, or search areas. Delivery is charged after the discount and before tax, so the waived amount is also excluded from the taxed base; the threshold is evaluated against the post-discount, pre-delivery, pre-tax order value. Per the README convention that each module owns its own test file, new coverage goes only in test/total.test.js: a case at or above the threshold paying no delivery, a case below it paying three pounds, and the boundary at exactly one hundred pounds being free. Existing total.test.js cases use baskets of 20 and 50 pounds, which stay below the threshold and remain valid.

plan.objective: Customers who have placed more than twenty five orders should get fifteen percent off instead of ten
plan.intent: Modify existing loyalty discount behavior in src/pricing/discount.js by raising the LOYAL_ORDERS threshold constant from 10 to 25 and the LOYAL_RATE constant from 0.1 to 0.15; no discount tier is added, removed, enabled, or disabled, and the discountRate signature, its zero-discount fallbacks for undefined customers and non-qualifying customers, and orderTotal's call site in src/pricing/total.js remain unchanged. Tests are confined to test/discount.test.js per the README's one-test-file-per-module rule; existing assertions (orders 50 > 0, orders 1 === 0, undefined === 0) still hold, and boundary coverage for orders 25 (no discount) and 26 (0.15) may be added there.

test/tax.test.js: tax is charged on a standard order
test/tax.test.js: tax is charged when a mixed order has any physical line
